family.description: SpoIIM is on e of four stage II sporulation proteins that is necessary for the forespore inside the mother-cell to be properly internalised through the breakdown of peptidoglycans trapped between the membranes of the septum separating the forespore and the mother-cell. The four proteins working in sequence are SpoIIB, [pfam:PF05036], SpoIIM, SpoIIP, [pfam:PF07454], and finally SpoIID, [pfam:PF08486]. D, M and P are in a complex with each other and the complex assembles in a hierarchical manner such that M, which serves as a membrane anchor, recruits P to the septum and P, in turn, recruits D to the septum [[cite:PUB00109154]].
family.name: Stage II sporulation protein M

discussions.notes: Preserve Aung Figure 3D KP722/KP764 and Chastanet Abs292/Abs216 discrepancies. Reference P37873 is strain 168; experiments use PY79 derivatives. See evidence/PF01944/identity.txt and coverage.txt.
discussions.prompt: Resolve construct discrepancies and physical mechanisms behind SpoIIM localization and suppression phenotypes.
discussions.rationale: GFP targeting and allele-specific suppression do not establish direct molecular contact or SpoIIM hydrolase activity.

evidence.explanation: A modest plate-culture heat-resistance decrease differs from the nonsignificant result under Dembek's liquid-culture conditions; neither establishes universal SpoIIM necessity.
LcyD abstract reports export/immunity observations, but full Methods and member mapping remain open; mature peptide in knockout cells does not demonstrate LcyD cyclase activity.

discussions.notes: Inspect remaining primary sources and exact constructs; do not convert joint DMP/AH perturbations to isolated SpoIIM effects. All corpus records and prior follow-ups remain in scope.
discussions.prompt: Resolve candidate homolog mapping and extend evidence coverage beyond the inspected Bacillus contexts.
discussions.rationale: Archaeal members and bacteriocin-associated proteins are not characterized by the sporulation name; C. difficile CD1221 lacks a verified current Pfam mapping here.
